CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

2. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   D. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

7. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

9. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   B. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   C. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Football.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Football.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

13. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

14. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

15. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Rounders and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
